capabilities: Draw function curves and geometric shapes on a coordinate grid
Compute intersection points and tangents that update as inputs change
Snap and attach drawing objects to points, lines and curves
Embed graphs in notes via link previews that count as backlinks
Export graphs to PNG, PDF, or the clipboard
disambiguation: Not the core graph view of notes; it draws mathematical figures on a coordinate grid.
extras: Everything runs locally with no network requests; graphs are stored as readable JSON files that are migrated on open; interface is bilingual English/French.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw mathematical or economics figures with plotted curves inside notes.
summary: Figure-drawing tool that creates .graph files with coordinate grids, function curves, shapes, computed intersections and tangents, exported to PNG and PDF.
